capabilities: Show untriaged inbox notes in a sidebar panel
Save a note by setting status to active and moving it to the organized folder
Discard a note to Obsidian's trash
Scan a configurable inbox folder for untriaged notes
Strip legacy inbox tags from older notes
disambiguation: Does not capture notes itself; it only triages notes already synced into the vault by an external server.
extras: Manual install only (build from source; not yet in the community plugin store). Architecture docs live in CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / GEMINI.md, not the README. Parts of the README (settings labels) are in Chinese.
problem: Notes captured by an external pipeline land in the vault unreviewed, and Obsidian has no built-in flow to quickly keep or discard each one.

relations.evidence: notes synced into your vault's inbox folder by the main Obsidian Inbox server

summary: Sidebar panel for triaging notes synced into your inbox folder by the obsidian-inbox server, with a keep or discard button per note.
